topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: The news hung in the air, a heavy fog between us. I listened as my best friend explained, her voice a mix of excitement and trepidation. I nodded, trying to take it all in, my mind racing to keep up. Moving across the country—it meant long distances and missed moments, but also new beginnings and adventures. I told her I was happy for her, because if anyone deserved a fresh start, it was her. We talked about keeping in touch, about visits and video calls, and I promised to be there, no matter what. The miles might change, but some things, I reassured her, will always stay the same.
